lines.text: Vodafone Networks buys through one hundred and forty-five categories.
Seven hundred and sixty million euros of spend, this year alone.
What if you could see all of it... at once?
Every category is a plot of land. A blueprint lays the foundation.
Progress raises the tower. Spend builds the houses, and the hotels.
And where A.I. is at work, the rooftop lights up.
Four. Only four have ever been used.
Field Maintenance. Seventy-five million euros of spend, and no blueprint at all.
Twenty categories like it carry a hundred and seventy-six million.
So ask the city. Its agent finds the gaps, reasons over the data, and takes you there.
And this... is the city we could be.
Today, Networks scores nineteen out of a hundred. The fastest way up is not writing more.
It is using what we have already written.
Complete the blueprint. Put it to work through AVA Sourcing.
Use it for real sourcing events. And build the knowledge that powers what comes next.
